question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH multi_occurrence_donors AS (SELECT "Donor" FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_occurrence_donors) THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM("Amount"), 0), 0) AS percent, COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS num_donors FROM donations WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_occurrence_donors)

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH multi_occurrence_donors AS (
    SELECT "Donor"
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_occurrence_donors) THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM("Amount"), 0) AS percent,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS num_donors
FROM donations
WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_occurrence_donors);
```
